content.title: WWE NXT Stand & Deliver 2026 live streaming Countdown show
content.text: Sean Rueter has been thinking too much about pro wrestling since at least WrestleMania I, and blogging about it for SBNation & Cageside Seats since around WrestleMania 28.WWE NXT Stand & Deliver is tonight (Sat., April 4, 2026) at 7 pm ET from St. Louis’ The Factory at The District, which will be the first of the brand’s premium live events to debut on YouTube in the U.S. and Netflix for the most of the rest of the world. To get us ready, an hour beforehand NXT is offering their regular free live streaming Countdown show on all their online channels — which means all you have to do is click play above!You’ll get all the usual highlight packages to get you up to speed on all the feuds and angles heading into Stand & Deliver, plus a ten-person mixed tag match between Hank and Tank, Shiloh Hill, EK Prosper & Wren Sinclair and the new Birth Right group of TNA Knockouts champion Arianna Grace, Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo, Lexis King, Uriah Connors and Charlie Dempsey.It starts at 6 pm ET. We hope you’ll join us here for the live stream you see above!We’ve got a preview of the entire show here, and staff predictions for each match here. And of course, complete results and live match coverage of the entire Stand & Deliver event can be found by clicking here.0 Comments
